CSS Shape Generator

Generate CSS shapes — triangles, circles, stars, hexagons, diamonds and more — with live preview and copy-ready CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a shape, size and color from the controls.
  2. Watch the live preview update as you change options.
  3. Copy the generated CSS or download it as a .css file.
  4. Paste the .csg-shape rule into your project and add the class to any element.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which shapes are supported?

Triangle (4 directions), circle, oval, square, diamond, pentagon, hexagon, star, cross, arrow, chevron, parallelogram and trapezoid.

How are the shapes drawn?

Triangles use the classic border trick; all other shapes use clip-path polygons, so they scale cleanly at any size.

Will the CSS work in all browsers?

Border triangles and border-radius shapes work everywhere. clip-path polygons work in all modern browsers; very old browsers ignore them.

Can I change the color later?

Yes — every shape takes its color from a single background or border-color value you can edit freely.
